sources.intro: Where the loop pulls listings from. Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby and a dozen more ATS and remote-job feeds are supported. Register one with the form below — the listings section then fetches from your sources automatically (or on demand). Claude can still drive the same thing over MCP.
sources.emptyTitle: Connect a job board or RSS feed.
sources.emptyHint: Register one with the form below — pick a source kind, give it a label and config.

screenAssistant.intro: A desktop app that listens to the other side of your interview call and writes cue cards from your corpus, scoped to the role you pick. The cards stream here too — open this page on your phone and keep the desktop window minimized.
screenAssistant.emptyHint: Start a session in the desktop app. What it hears and the cards it writes show up here live.

listings.intro: Jobs fetched from your registered sources, held in a 1-day pool. Ask Claude to rank them against your corpus and draft a resume for the ones worth applying to. Anything you don't draft or discard within the day drops back out of the pool.
listings.emptyTitle: Fetch jobs from your sources first.
listings.emptyHint: Listings are fetched automatically when you open this section — or press Fetch now. Results stay here for a day until you draft or discard them.
listings.pendingSources: {count, plural, one {# source still fetching in the background — the list updates when it is done} other {# sources still fetching in the background — the list updates when they are done}}
listings.titleInPool: {count, plural, one {# in pool} other {# in pool}}

drafts.intro: Tailored resumes Claude drafted for jobs you said yes to. Open the composer to edit + preview; <ink>send</ink> freezes the snapshot, renders the final PDF (with QR), and auto-issues an AccessCode.
drafts.emptyHint: Ask Claude to draft a resume from a shortlisted job listing (MCP resume.draft) — it shows up here.
drafts.committed: Application committed — résumé sent with its access code
drafts.discardBody: This permanently removes the draft. It can't be undone.
drafts.hoursLeft: {count, plural, one {# hour left} other {# hours left}}
drafts.newFromHint: A draft is a copy of the master: editing the draft never touches the master.

masters.heading: masters · never expire
masters.hint: New drafts start here. A draft you tailored can be saved back with “set as master”.
masters.emptyHint: Save a draft as a master from its composer, or start a blank one.
masters.deleteBody: Drafts that started from it keep their content; they just stop naming it.
masters.saveAsMasterTitle: Save this draft as a master
masters.saveAsMasterBody: Only the résumé content is saved — no job, no access code. A master never expires.
masters.overwriteHint: this draft came from it · its content is replaced
masters.makeDefault: make it the default (new drafts start from it)
masters.banner: This is a master, not tied to any job: there is no send and no access code here. To apply, start a draft from it.

applications.intro: Every committed application — frozen resume snapshot + auto-issued AccessCode. Recruiters scan the QR on the PDF and land directly in your chat. Click a card to review timeline + status + private notes.
applications.emptyHint: Draft a resume from a shortlisted job listing, then send to commit it here.

detail.notesReadOnly: read-only for now — nothing stores notes yet, so this box would lose whatever you typed
detail.needsWriter: not available yet — this instance has no way to record a status change; commit is the only write on this path
detail.pdfNotKept: not available here — the rendered PDF is handed to your AI client at commit and is not kept on the application, so there is nothing for this panel to open

resume.alsoText: The QR is a live chat with my AI · grounded in my corpus · scoped for {company}.
resume.footerSnapshot: this resume is a snapshot · sent {date}
